intro: A clearer way to route your traffic. RouteLoom is building one self-hosted proxy experience for your desktop, phone, and cloud server.
notice: Windows, Ubuntu and Android previews. Apple signing is required. Private server profile needed.
panelCaption: Illustrative rule preview · no traffic is sent
sampleTitle: A small rule. A clear decision.
sampleText: Choose an example to see how a routing policy could work. This demo runs only in your browser.
sampleResults: PROXY — the default server route matches.
BLOCK — the explicit domain rule matches.
howIntro: Deploy a server, import a device profile, and connect. All five clients support routing rules, traffic monitoring and the China/LAN direct preset.
steps: Run your encrypted tunnel server on Debian with the tested service setup.
Load a private profile with an independent identity for each device.
Start VPN capture and grant your operating system permission.
platformTitle:
Downloads for today.

platformIntro: Get the experimental alpha for Windows, Ubuntu or Android. macOS and iOS use the source signing kit until signed distribution is ready.
appleNote: Apple VPN apps require your developer signing and provisioning. The signing kit is source code, not an installable DMG/IPA. Physical-device checks remain pending.
roadmapIntro: Downloads are experimental. Here is what works and what remains before a complete five-platform release.
milestones: Bilingual interface, rule/PAC CLI, website and build checks.
TLS 1.3, native capture and a tested Debian cloud server.
Traffic dashboard on all five platforms, Auto/Proxy/Direct modes, China routing, reconnect, profiles and updates.
Signed Apple distribution, physical-device tests, network transitions and security review.
footerText: Read the source, follow development, or help shape the first release.
footerNote: Apache-2.0 · English & 简体中文 · Self-hosted by design
docsIntro: Download an alpha client and connect to your own RouteLoom server. Apple installation still requires your signing setup.
docsSections: Use the installation guide below. Windows bundles its runtime and helper; Ubuntu installs a desktop app; Android provides an APK. Apple provides a source signing kit.
Apply the China and LAN direct preset or edit domain, CIDR, port and protocol rules. Inspect actual routes in Traffic. Auto DNS still resolves through the server.
Flutter 3.50.0 and the pinned Rust toolchain are used by the release builds. English and Simplified Chinese are included.
The Debian guide includes service accounts, TLS configuration, firewall/NAT, restart checks and an external tunnel probe.
Protection depends on platform controls; Android needs system lockdown. Personally signed Apple updates require Xcode. Physical-device validation and signed Apple distribution remain pending.
